title: secure-site-access.sh can isolate a quickstart EmDash site: render-compose keeps its tracy/<template>-emdash[-tools] image and mounts the access key
steps: S1: Run render-compose.test.mjs: a site dir with PLATFORM=emdash, compose image tracy/tracy-base-emdash:0.5.6-tools (and tracy/tracy-business-emdash:1.7.23-tools), the network-isolated marker and .site-access/<label>/key.json; render it the way secure-site-access.sh does (strict).
S2: Same with the plain template image tracy/tracy-business-emdash:1.7.23 and no marker.
S3: Same with an image outside Tracy's namespace (ghcr.io/someone/shop-emdash:1.0).
expect: S1: the render succeeds; the image line is exactly the one the site ran; the web service is on [default] only, no tracy_tracy network; the key directory is mounted read-only at /run/tracy-access.
S2: the render succeeds and the image line is unchanged.
S3: the render is refused with 'refusing rather than moving it' and the compose file is byte-for-byte unchanged.
evidence: 26/10/2026: secure-site-access.sh failed on every EmDash site (prod1 base-emdash, business-emdash; 15 on dev) with '!! tracy/tracy-base-emdash:0.5.6-tools is not a tracy/emdash tag ... refusing rather than moving it', so EmDash sites stayed on the shared tracy_tracy network and could reach every other site's container by name.
fence: Static: render-compose.sh against temp site dirs with --no-image-check; no docker, no stand.

tests: P0: a quickstart EmDash site (-tools image) re-renders isolated, on exactly the image it runs
a quickstart EmDash image without -tools is kept too
an EmDash site on an image outside Tracy's namespace is still refused, compose untouched
